hook: You can walk across a whole country in minutes.
title: You can walk across this whole country
description:
Monaco covers only about 2 square kilometres on the French Riviera, making it the second-smallest country in the world after the Vatican. France surrounds it on every land side, yet Formula 1 races through its streets. Part of the Places That Shouldn't Exist series.

#Shorts #Monaco #PlacesThatShouldntExist
